mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
